limitations: Not all AI-assisted texts require marking; assess Article 50 scope and actual editorial exemption.
Disclosure or technical metadata alone does not cure prohibited uses, unlawful processing or unverified facts.
AI-assisted public-interest content with superficial or merely automated checks is not treated as genuinely human-reviewed.
